params.body:
Closes #984

`Photo::old_remove_background()` sent the original to remove.bg without checking it was there. A missing or empty file went out as an empty `image_file_b64`; remove.bg answered 400 `missing_source` ("No image given"), which is not an image-level refusal, so it was reported (Nightwatch #61) and the tile said the service refused.

The real path now does what `ProcessImage::fakeRemoveBg()` already did: no file, an empty file or no path at all means no call to remove.bg, a warning with the photo id and path, and `PhotoFailure::SOURCE_MISSING`, which the job already turns into the "original is no longer on the server" reason on the tile. The bytes read for the check are the ones that are sent, so the disk is read once.

Why the original was gone for that photo is not answered here.

Tests: a new case in `RemoveBackgroundTest` (missing file, empty file, null path: nothing sent, nothing reported, row untouched), which fails on main. Full suite green locally (3041 tests).

Portal: A photo whose original is no longer on the server now says so, instead of reporting an error from the background removal service.
params.title: Do not send remove.bg an empty image when the original is missing
